scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: wide landscape inline picture-book painting for a Japanese graded-reading story
Primary request: illustrate the end of paragraph 0 of “Urashima Tarō”: after buying a turtle from the children, Tarō returns it to the sea and it swims away.
Scene/backdrop: A quiet stretch of Japanese shoreline with a few smooth rocks, pale sand, a softly rolling blue sea and distant low cliffs. Keep the background open and simple.
Subject: A young Japanese fisherman with dark hair tied in a small topknot wears a plain muted indigo kimono and simple sandals. He has just gently guided a green sea turtle back into the shallow water; the turtle is now swimming freely toward the gentle waves. Two children stand a little way back, calm and empty-handed after the exchange. A simple woven fishing basket rests on the sand near Tarō.
Style/medium: children's picture-book gouache in the approved simple inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gently curved contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background. Use warm ivory sand, muted indigo, sage-teal water and soft ochre. Keep the drawing much simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape about 12:7, medium-wide side view; Tarō and the turtle are the clear focal pair near the waterline, with the children small and secondary. Two or three calm depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft coastal daylight, compassionate and peaceful.
Constraints: show the turtle safe and swimming away; no written text, lettering, title, labels, border or watermark. Original composition.
Avoid: copying a portrait-cover layout, distressed turtle, rough handling, weapons, extra people, dramatic waves, photorealism, dense texture, elaborate details, logos.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: second wide landscape inline picture-book painting for a Japanese graded-reading story
Primary request: illustrate the end of paragraph 1 of “Urashima Tarō”: Tarō rides the turtle down through the blue sea, reaches the Dragon Palace and is welcomed by Princess Otohime.
Scene/backdrop: A calm underwater space near the sea floor. A simple pale coral-and-ivory palace gate stands among broad sea plants, with a few small fish and smooth blue water shapes.
Subject: The same young Japanese fisherman Tarō with dark hair in a small topknot, wearing his plain muted indigo kimono, rides on the back of the same large green sea turtle with a softly patterned shell. At the palace gate, Otohime, a graceful young Japanese princess with long dark hair, wears a simple pale ivory kimono with a muted coral sash and teal details; she welcomes him with one open hand. Keep all characters friendly and calm.
Style/medium: children's picture-book gouache in the approved simple inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gently curved contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and soft shadows, quiet simplified background. Use layered blue and teal water, warm ivory, muted coral and indigo. Keep the shapes broad and the detail much simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape about 12:7, medium-wide view; the turtle and rider lead toward the palace gate, where Otohime is clearly visible. Two or three gentle depth layers only.
Lighting/mood: soft luminous underwater light, peaceful wonder and welcome.
Constraints: one Tarō, one turtle, one princess; no lettering, title, text, labels, border or watermark. Original composition.
Avoid: copying the cover's beach setting, giant complex palace, underwater clutter, extra people, menacing creatures, photorealism, dense texture, dramatic contrast, logos.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: third wide landscape inline picture-book painting for a Japanese graded-reading story
Primary request: illustrate the end of paragraph 2 of “Urashima Tarō”: Tarō longs for home, and the sad but kind Princess Otohime gives him a beautiful closed jewelled box and asks him not to open it.
Scene/backdrop: A quiet chamber in the Dragon Palace, with a simple open doorway to blue water, a few broad flower and sea-glass shapes, and minimal decoration.
Subject: The same young Japanese fisherman Tarō with dark hair in a small topknot and a plain muted indigo kimono sits facing Otohime. The graceful young princess has long dark hair and a simple pale ivory kimono with muted coral and teal accents. She gently offers him one small beautiful closed lacquer box with a few restrained gold details. Tarō receives it carefully, looking thoughtful; Otohime's expression is tender and slightly sad. Do not open the box.
Style/medium: children's picture-book gouache in the approved simple inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gently curved contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and soft shadows, quiet simplified background. Use layered teal and blue, warm ivory, restrained coral, indigo and a little soft gold. Keep ornament minimal and the detail simpler than cover art.
Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape about 12:7, medium-wide seated two-shot. Make the closed box clearly visible between them, with both faces and hands readable. Two or three calm depth layers.
Lighting/mood: soft luminous palace light, gentle farewell and quiet mystery.
Constraints: one closed box only; it remains unopened. No smoke, aging, lettering, text, title, labels, border or watermark. Original composition.
Avoid: copying the beach cover, open lid, visible contents, magical smoke, frightening imagery, extra people, elaborate palace decoration, photorealism, dense texture, logos.
